title: Village loop plan and checkpoint: actual later consumers and precise return evidence
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: full plan/receipt content review; later bounded delivery qualifies early missing-consumer and queue claims
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all438 original lines: GF1–GF9, VC1–VC12/VC2n/VC3a/VC7a/VC9-0, VP1–VP3, LD1–LD8, WD1–WD5, H1–H3, RT1–RT3, WR1–WR10, all five loop cards/contrast rows and UF1–UF7. These are scoped October27 proposals and dispatch history. Current PROJECT and the later campaign/entry/activity/UI owners govern work; the old Village-first priority and proposed dated PROJECT insertion are not current instructions. The six-step loop and world verbs are useful design lenses, not exhaustive definitions of every life.

F2: The fully read Village checkpoint supplies later progress missing from the plan's first-version tables and final uncommitted-VL1 note: VL1 watch service has a recorded fresh-life/native/browser/persistence route; VC3a forfeit/description/current-arrival note, VC2n earned parcel access and VC12 fitted evening cards have their own dated receipts. This supersedes the blanket outputs-have-no-consumers/no-next-choice diagnosis for those consumers. It does not establish relay completion, all traveler asks, generic absence automation, all deck cards or current installed behavior. The feared market-circle backlash/double-count is explicitly checked negative in the checkpoint; it is not an outstanding reproduced defect.

F3: VC2n implements the Village-specific Known Face4 threshold (two+2 watches), superseding the earlier10/five-watch proposal as recorded runtime shape without promoting WD2 to user-accepted universal tuning. It preserves the pamphlet route, begun relays after reputation loss and other ladders. VC3a's actual note reads waiting windows on an observed arrival into the main log, not a departure diff through change_badges/event_feed; reminders may repeat. Publication-order refresh was corrected during its route. Partial Persistence learning remains despite forfeit of completion pay/XP/reputation; ACR7 uses actual phase settlement rather than zeroing all partial benefit. Exact watch duration depends on the admitted local action/clock, not every life owing a fixed13hours.

F4: Red-team rulings preserve source differences: narrowed existing-row access replaces a proposed new ask/career flow; VC12 reuses deck facts rather than served-person casting; new stock/spoilage stays banked for an actual need; absence work remains under AD16/current actual support, not a special-cheat entitlement. VC7a carry rows/confirm is narrower than usable imported making, and three unbuilt sibling worlds are not the cheapest existing test. Preserve original VC9/VC10/VC11 and credits/deviation/save-fingerprint ideas without porting, branching, permission outreach or publication here. A fingerprint alone is not migration or matched fidelity. Current PROJECT keeps sibling worlds proposed and Proto23-derived push dependent on explicit authority.

F5: LD2 already qualifies the cross-world Village-home shorthand: home follows a life/choice, not every Tingen life returning to Village. Learning, digestion and world-absence clocks follow their actual carrier/world rules, not a universal Tingen-only advancement restriction. R9-PW codes stay distinct from the intro PW family. Source-audit readings of faithful worlds are not shipped packs; LOTM/HP school/trade snapshots are not the later Klein/Harry developer routes or all-world coverage. WR proposals and critic recommendations are not accepted rules or new mandatory review gates. AD42 keeps good-evenings/taste feedback optional; AD51 qualifies old second-world prerequisites. Every action need not differ on every contrast-table row for worlds to retain meaningful overall identities.

F6: Preserve shared homes/cheat views, known orientation, actual carry and cause/knowledge projections. The pinned-box name is corrected by B567's coverage-plan/work-line routing; do not create another owner for it. New view/model/primitive, no-fixture-only floor, mandatory screenshot-size matrix and old worker ownership are not universal requirements; current AD36/AD43 permits named fixtures and task-specific evidence. No linked runtime/source/image/save was opened, no receipt rerun, no gameplay, worker/message, migration, deletion, move, commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: Actually read all original1–438 in recovered untruncated standalone chunks; current master Round7/8 sections and prior B137 semantic receipt inspected. No runtime/source/artifact rerun.
reviews.reopen: Retain current priority and source-local proof limits; selected relay/absence/carry work needs its real current supplier and journey, not the old queue.

reviews.classification: full plan/receipt content review; later bounded delivery qualifies early missing-consumer and queue claims
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all140 original lines: survey, VL1/VC3a/VC2n/VC12 contracts, every verification row, cross-world seams and chronological log. Initial combined output truncation was recovered with standalone1–70/71–140 reads before credit. This is receipt review, not fresh code/build/browser/persistence inspection. The plan's all-pending/uncommitted status is superseded for the four recorded slices at these exact historical scopes; current PROJECT governs later priorities.

F2: VL1's watch route actually reports reputation/trade/publication and Save/Export/Import/re-Export, with fresh-life provenance and explicit bundles. Relay+3 is action-path unit-tested but not walked; the initial playable/gated survey and later parcel access do not prove three-handoff receipt settlement. The market-circle concern was checked as a separate owner/price contribution, with no observed double count or rival backlash. Preserve publication refresh correction. VC2n's later4 threshold supersedes old10/fifth-watch evidence locally, not all ladders or the historical result. The source-edited/committed dial does not itself prove user tuning acceptance or every future save safely reverts in one line.

F3: VC3a distinguishes forfeited completion coins/Perception XP/reputation from retained earned Persistence XP and a parcel waiting while travel/rest happens. Its main-log arrival note lists current waits, not what was missed/changed during absence; no departure timestamp was added, reminders can repeat and load/repeated clock/staying does not trigger a new arrival. Standing sentence was fixed to refresh after publication in place. The clean committed bundle differs from earlier shared-tree browser bundles containing foreign UI edits; identical owned slice code does not establish pixel parity of every other dependency. Named relay text/receipt reminder and21px remain unexercised at that snapshot.

F4: VC2n's existing courier/pamphlet route stays open, the new earned standing route opens after two watch completions and a begun relay remains open after standing falls. Reaching a gate is not completing the mill/Cave-room route. VC12's watch evening/lamplighter contact/paid wick follow-up is the native shown slice; mill-cart and supper rows remain unit-tested only. Temper affects quiet weight, with fixed-seed30-day ordering and default-draw parity reported; it is not guaranteed every arbitrary evening yields a card. Removal of the self-lock occurred after the browser run, so later recurring behavior has separate proof scope. Saved actor fact for temper uses an existing namespace, but that still changes persisted content semantics even without a new top-level field.

F5: Keep14px1920/1536 evidence, missing21px, headless-tool limit, clean full-suite and committed identities distinct; reading them does not revalidate today's gameplay or installed app. Missing elder dialogue ID and parked encounter discoverability are dated findings, not freshly reproduced defects or already repaired by this review. Cross-world/Proto23 seams are suggestions: generic reputation publication does not authorize every pack's scale, mapping/native region validation and ladder definition serve different contracts. Home/return shorthand remains per-life; ACR1–ACR14 and current WER/continuation owners govern actual carry, clocks and earned partial work. No current gameplay, private save, source acquisition, worker, migration, deletion, commit or push.

folds.heading: ## Village plan and receipt reconciliation B569
folds.body: The full [Village GM-plan review](gm/dispatch/village-loop-2026-10-27/GM_PLAN.md#content-reconciliation-b569-later-village-consumers-and-current-scope) and [Village checkpoint review](gm/dispatch/village-loop-2026-10-27/VILLAGE_LOOP_CHECKPOINT.md#content-reconciliation-b569-watch-relay-and-return-evidence) qualify Round7 VL4/GF1's mostly-proposals/no-consumer diagnosis. The later checkpoint records watch reputation/trade and persistence, earned parcel access at the Village-specific4 threshold, standing text/forfeit/current-wait arrival note and the lamplighter follow-up. Relay completion, larger text and other fitted cards retain their narrower unit-only or unexercised scope. The market-circle double-count lead was checked negative there. VC3a's actual return note is current waiting state in the main log, not an absence diff through change badges/event feed; keep that distinction under ACR5/6/7/8/9. Proposed stock/spoilage, served-person casting, absence routines, sibling packs and cross-world making survive as conditional ideas, not a revived work queue. Current PROJECT's Klein/HP priorities, home/entry rules and AD36/AD42/AD43/AD51 govern selected work; no fresh native or source proof follows from reading these receipts.
